name: playwright-testing
description: Use this skill for anything about Playwright end-to-end tests: planning coverage for a flow, writing or refactoring spec files, or fixing flaky/failing tests and hardening a suite for CI. Covers what to test and test-plan format, locator strategy (getByRole first), web-first assertions, composable fixtures vs the Page Object Model, storageState authentication, killing flakiness, network mocking, the trace viewer, and healing tests broken by legitimate UI changes. Pick it for 'plan / write / add / refactor Playwright tests', 'test is flaky', or 'passes locally but fails in CI'.
human_description: Plan, write, and stabilize Playwright e2e tests
